followup_explanation:
I weighed two things: capability and task fit.

**Capability:** Petrel scores meaningfully higher than Avocet across the board — IFEval (89.8 vs 85.6), Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4), and the most relevant internal evals here, Extraction & Retrieval (85.3 vs 81.6) and Summarization (86.4 vs 80.3). These gaps exceed the 2.0-point variance threshold, so they're real, not noise. Your task is essentially structured extraction and organization (turning a process description into roles and responsibilities), which lands squarely in those eval categories.

**Task fit / preferences:** The only documented difference between the two models in their *preference* profiles is around harm-adjacent or distasteful-but-permissible content. Your query is completely benign business content, so that distinction doesn't apply and gives Avocet no reason to be preferred. With preferences neutral, capability is the deciding factor.

So Petrel wins on the metrics that matter for this task, with nothing pulling the other way. That's why I routed it there.
